title: PEPA Bruce office closes for one hour Thursday; dispatcher stays available
excerpt: PEPA’s Bruce office will close from 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Nov. 19 for its employee Thanksgiving meal. An outage and emergency dispatcher remains available.
locality: PEPA Bruce office, Bruce, Calhoun County, Mississippi; regional utility notice from Pontotoc Electric Power Association.
